groups.defect: tagDeviceUI puts the device key in localCache (impl.go:87) before CreateOrUpdateDevice runs and does not remove it when the write fails with ErrDeviceLimitReached. A rejected device then hits the cache for 29 minutes, tagDeviceUI returns nil, and the device limit is bypassed. Fix: set the cache entry only after a successful write, or delete the key on error.

answer.reasoning:
All three suggestions describe the same defect, and the diff confirms it. The cache key is set at impl.go:87 before the database write and is not removed when the write fails. Because of that, a device rejected for ErrDeviceLimitReached gets past the limit for the 29-minute cache lifetime. All three also propose the same fix: write the cache entry only after the write succeeds, or delete it on error.

The line ranges differ (144-148 is where TagDevice now passes the error up; 87-95 is the cache write), but both are in the same file and both refer to the same cache line. One edit in tagDeviceUI fixes the whole thing, so the kind is same_location rather than cross_location.
